description: Rolling screenshot capture correlated with ETW events.
pre_install: if (-not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or -not ((dotnet --list-runtimes 2>$null) -match '^Microsoft\.NETCore\.App 10\.')) { error 'ETWSnap requires the .NET 10 Runtime. Install it with: winget install Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.10'; break }
notes: Install it with: winget install Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.10
